meta.title: Store operations manager at a multi-location resort retailer
meta.industry: Resort retail, six shops across two resorts
meta.blurb: Runs day-to-day operations across the shops: staffing, schedules, standards and issues.

opportunities.quote: About 60 emails a day, a lot of them notifications and approvals
opportunities.why: You get a high volume of email in Outlook, much of it notifications and approvals that you sort and archive.
opportunities.firstStep: Turn on the inbox summary each morning and copy its action items into your to-do list for a week.
opportunities.failureMode: Summaries miss the one message that mattered, so important senders still need a rule that flags them.

habits.name: Grouping similar tasks
becauseTasks: Teams: Morning shop check-ins, Answer shop managers' questions, Operations review with leadership
habits.firstStep: Put the tasks that use the same tool into one block on your calendar.
habits.failureMode: Blocks get booked over unless they are marked busy.

rules.name: Task is in the task map
Quoted evidence appears word for word in the visitor's answers
Pattern is in the catalog and every required signal was recorded
Tool is listed on the pattern, with a working link checked within the limit
Hours figures are the ones code computed
A working-habit suggestion carries no hours unless the catalog supplies a share

transcript.question: For "Walk the shops", how many shops do you visit in a typical week, and what do you use while there?
How many emails do you triage in the inbox on a typical day?
transcript.answer: About 60 emails a day, a lot of them notifications and approvals. That's over 50, so 50 to 100.

transcript.question: For "Triage the inbox", where do most emails come from, and where do they go once handled?
options: Shop managers; replies back to them

transcript.question: For "Walk the shops", what prompts a visit, and who receives your findings afterward?
options: Fixed weekly route; notes to leadership
Fixed route; notes to shop managers
transcript.answer: Fixed route; notes to shop managers

transcript.question: For "Build next week's staff schedule", where do the availability details come from, and who receives the finished schedule?
options: Last week's sheet; sent to shop managers
Staff texts and emails; shared in Teams
HR system data; sent to payroll
